titleHtml: Who Is Leopold Aschenbrenner? The Whole Saga, A to Z.
excerptHtml: From a 165-page essay to a $45 billion AI hedge fund to a forced fire sale to Citadel in a single week — the whole story, explained from zero, plus the one lesson about leverage that matters more than being right.

titleHtml: Claude Cowork Bet on One Model. We Didn't.
excerptHtml: Anthropic's new coworker agent is genuinely good — and permanently capped by whatever Claude can do this week. Model-agnostic wrappers like Viktor and Perplexity Computer don't have that ceiling. That gap is the whole game.

titleHtml: The Moat Is Not the Model.
excerptHtml: Being the best frontier lab and the best consumer product are two different games. Why distribution and deeply user-oriented design — not the model — decide who wins the end user, and why model-agnostic wrappers like Perplexity and Manus are built to win it.

titleHtml: How to Build Your Own Specialized Agent Like Viktor.
excerptHtml: A build playbook for shipping a specialized AI agent — with its own inbox, phone number, and Slack seat — modeled on Viktor but going deeper into one money-making function: accounts receivable.
A short note on why we built Appsurd, what "absurd" means to us, and what you can expect to find on this page over the coming months.
